title: An App Designer page save deletes and re-inserts every row of the page, changed or not
statement: On Save, App Designer physically rewrites the page: the PSPNLDEFN row and every PSPNLFIELD and PSPNLFIELDEXT row of the page get new ROWIDs (deleted and re-inserted), though by key only the changed controls differ. Inferred from flashback ROWID diffs; an UPDATE would keep the ROWID. Studio's page writer updates the changed rows in place, which gives the same keyed result.
